result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer includes products with zero stock. The fix is one condition in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, which matches how the other stock overviews filter.

`StockOverviewTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline (`mvn -q -o test`, no output, so no failures). I did not add a regression test for the WH-1 example, to keep the change small. The per-product quantity lookup (`findStockQuantity`) is untouched, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0. Nothing is committed.
